root.label: Trump holds out on new Taiwan arms package

events.label: Trump holds out on new Taiwan arms package

slots.name: package value
slots.sentence: Trump said in May, after meeting Xi in Beijing, that he was holding out on a new $14bn package for Taiwan, though he did approve one worth $11bn in December 2025.

slots.name: package status
slots.sentence: That package has stalled after U.S. President Donald Trump in May met with China’s President Xi Jinping in May.
